knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson says to keep a safe distance, avoid confrontation, leave when threatened and contact police or emergency services for immediate danger.
Resumption depends on the responsible person confirming the situation is controlled and the work plan is safe.
The lesson says to record exact words or observations without diagnosis, and to avoid sharing sensitive details.

practicalCriteria: Learner identifies early warning signs in a supplied scenario and names the first step to take.
Learner uses calm, short statements and keeps a safe distance and an exit available during a role-played escalation.
Learner stops the work, tells the person they are leaving and leaves when the role-played escalation continues, then records the incident.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Incident record for each threat, aggression or unsafe condition, with time, people, words and actions
Record of the escalation, the person notified and any external report made
stopWorkCriteria: Learner physically restrains or detains a person
Learner blocks the exit during an escalation
Learner approaches a loose or aggressive animal
